title: Culturally-Aware GenAI Risks: Perspectives from Youth, Parents, and Teachers in a Non-Western Context

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of social media posts (Reddit, X/Twitter) and semi-structured interviews with Saudi Arabian youth, parents, and teachers to identify instances where GenAI outputs and interaction paradigms conflict with non-Western cultural norms, family dynamics, and expectations of modesty and honor.

Qualitative evaluation of user experiences from interviews and social media to identify how GenAI models misinterpret Islamic fundamentals, fabricate religious rulings (Fatwas), alter Quranic verses, and provide moral advice contradicting Islamic teachings.

Analysis of self-reported user interactions highlighting GenAI's limitations in understanding and generating accurate Arabic (particularly complex or Quranic Arabic) and instances of the models erroneously confusing Arabic with the Persian language.
